brief:
The United States conducted an airstrike targeting an Iranian wedding, Drop Site News reported. Details of casualties and the circumstances surrounding the strike remained unclear, though the attack underscored deepening military tensions in the region.

Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu visited Gaza and declared that Israel would not withdraw from the territory, rejecting calls for a military pullout. His statement reinforced Israel's stated intention to maintain a long-term presence in the enclave despite mounting international pressure over the humanitarian toll of the conflict.

The United Nations announced that global temperatures will exceed the 1.5-degree Celsius warming threshold set by the Paris Agreement, marking a critical failure to meet the international climate target that scientists have warned against for years.
title: U.S. airstrike kills wedding attendees as Netanyahu vows Gaza occupation
